title: Fix Terra Vedant Tech header logo static asset paths and add resilient fallback rendering

requirements.summary: Ensure the Terra Vedant Tech logo PNGs exist under frontend public static assets with the exact filenames and casing used by the app.
acceptanceCriteria: Loading `/assets/generated/terravedant-logo.dim_128x128.png` directly in the browser returns HTTP 200 (not 404) in both local dev and deployed build.

file_operations.description: Add the required 128x128 square logo file at this exact path and filename/casing so `/assets/generated/terravedant-logo.dim_128x128.png` is served as a static asset.
Add the required 512x512 square logo file at this exact path and filename/casing so `/assets/generated/terravedant-logo.dim_512x512.png` is served as a static asset.

requirements.summary: Make SiteHeader logo rendering resilient by adding an image load failure fallback (swap to large logo and/or text-only brand mark) without changing the header layout beyond what’s needed.
acceptanceCriteria: If `/assets/generated/terravedant-logo.dim_128x128.png` fails to load, the header still shows a visible brand mark (fallback image or text) without throwing runtime errors.
When the logo file exists, the image renders at all responsive breakpoints currently supported by the header (mobile, tablet, desktop).

file_operations.description: Add resilient logo rendering: implement `onError` handling to swap the `` source from `BRAND_ASSETS.logo.standard` to `BRAND_ASSETS.logo.large`, and if that also fails render a text-only brand mark (or hide the broken image) to prevent a broken header while keeping asset references as absolute `/assets/...` paths.
